item.description: Roots & Wings will host this annual event at The Montclair Art Museum. This year, we are excited to welcome back Christina Baker Kline, #1 New York Times bestselling author, to facilitate a riveting conversation with Paula McLain, Best-Selling author of The Paris Wife, Circling the Sun, and her recently released novel, Skylark. item.description:
Let's Walk!! JOIN US FOR A WALK. WE WALK AT A MODERATE PACE ON UNPAVED PATHS.
We will hike for about an hour - 3.5 miles. We will be walking on trails in the woods, so appropriate footwear, long pants & socks, and bug spray.
Will will meet at: [https://goo.gl/maps/7rRRTiXCntdE1neD7](https://goo.gl/maps/7rRRTiXCntdE1neD7) Eagle Rock Trail Parking Lot by Kiosk#1

item.title: Weekend Warrior Tennis (Saturdays) — Sat Oct 17, 9:00 AM
item.description:
North Jersey Bowling, Volleyball, Tennis & More Join us for friendly and sociable free rallies and possibly some informal matches for training and fun. We are beginner to intermediate levels but all are welcome. We don’t allow formal instruction on our group-reserved courts, although giving some quick tips is OK so long as you’re not holding up others waiting to play.
⛑️ **Clinic Matches:** If we have to rotate people in then we may play some clinic-style matches where everyone rotates in evenly. There is no holding the court via wins so everyone has a chance to play regardless of skill level.
🕊️ **Early Bird Start:** If you want to meet earlier than 9 AM (like 8 or 8:30) then please let us know by the day before and we’ll see who can join you (usually I can do earlier).
**🎾 Equipment:** Please bring your own racquet and water, as we don’t provide those. I always have some balls for at least one court, but feel free to bring your own in case we need to branch out over more than one

item.title: Tantra Date for Couples: Fall in Love — Sun Oct 18, 2:00 PM — the Space
item.description: Couples, This fall, slow down… and fall in love again. When the seasons change, we feel it in our bodies—cooler air, shorter days, a natural pull inward. It’s the perfect time to come home… to yourself and to each other. Most couples want more connection—more warmth, more affection, more real intimacy. But between busy schedules, stress, and “same-old” routines, it’s easy to drift into autopilot. And the truth is: no one ever taught us the simple skills that keep love alive. Welcome to a brand-new, transformational date experience designed to help you reconnect, reignite, and remember what brought you together in the first place. This isn’t talk therapy, and it’s not a lecture. It’s a guided, gentle, playful, deeply grounding experience where you’ll learn easy, practical tools to create closeness—tools you can use the very next day at home. item.title: What's Up with KidLit? Industry Experts Panel — Sun Sep 27, 1:30 PM — Online – Virtual
item.description: What’s Up with KidLit? Industry experts on crafting stories for young readers From enchanting picture books to riveting young adult novels, books have the power to turn young people into lifelong readers. But children’s literature has also become a battleground in the culture wars, readership is in deep decline, and AI is everywhere. What is the state of children’s literature today? And what will make your story stand out from the crowd? This panel features three industry professionals with comprehensive knowledge of the field. Our discussion will provide candid insights into the current children’s literary landscape, evolving children’s publishing trends, and provide practical tips for aspiring writers and insights for parents and educators into the unique challenges and opportunities of children’s publishing today. If you want a clear understanding of how books make a difference, and how yours can stand out in a competitive field, join us. PANELISTS: Maria Russo is an Editor-at-L
